from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    top_colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)}
    objects = {}
    for color in top_colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        objects[color] = pts
    ordered = sorted(objects, key=lambda color: min(c for r, c in objects[color]))
    direction_obj = objects[ordered[1]]
    chosen = objects[ordered[-1]]
    query = [(r, c) for r in range(divider + 1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    qminr = min(r for r, c in query) - (divider + 1)
    qmaxr = max(r for r, c in query) - (divider + 1)
    qminc, qmaxc = min(c for r, c in query), max(c for r, c in query)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h - divider - 6)]
    for r, c in query:
        out[r - (divider + 1)][c] = grid[r][c]
    dr0, dc0 = min(r for r, c in direction_obj), min(c for r, c in direction_obj)
    dr1, dc1 = max(r for r, c in direction_obj), max(c for r, c in direction_obj)
    rows = {r: sum(1 for rr, cc in direction_obj if rr == r) for r in range(dr0, dr1 + 1)}
    points_down = rows[dr1] > rows[dr0]
    cr0, cc0 = min(r for r, c in chosen), min(c for r, c in chosen)
    ch, cw = max(r for r, c in chosen) - cr0 + 1, max(c for r, c in chosen) - cc0 + 1
    target_c0 = qminc + (qmaxc - qminc + 1 - cw) // 2
    target_r0 = qminr - ch if points_down else qmaxr + 1
    color = grid[chosen[0][0]][chosen[0][1]]
    for r, c in chosen:
        rr, cc = target_r0 + r - cr0, target_c0 + c - cc0
        out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
program_path = program_dir / 'task-5d150bee.py'
program_path.write_text(program)
print(program_path, program_path.exists())
